name: Products Comparison for WooCommerce
author: Pluginbrew

sections.description:
Products Comparison for WooCommerce is a powerful yet lightweight plugin that enables your customers to compare multiple products side by side. With a modern UI and smart features, it makes decision-making easier, builds trust, and ultimately increases your store’s sales.

The plugin is built to provide meaningful comparisons. Customers can only compare products that belong to the same category, ensuring the results are always relevant and easy to understand. Store owners have full control over how the feature works — set the maximum number of products that can be compared and decide where the “Add to Compare” button should appear (product pages, shop pages, or both).

Lightweight in design and optimized for performance, Products Comparison for WooCommerce integrates seamlessly with your store and adapts to your workflow without slowing down your site.

Why choose Products Comparison for WooCommerce?
– Clean and modern design that fits perfectly with any theme.
– Customers can compare up to 10 products at once.
– Category-based comparison ensures relevant comparisons only.
– Fully responsive comparison table — works seamlessly on desktop and mobile.
– Simple configuration with intuitive settings.

Features

  • ✅ Enable/Disable comparison – Easily toggle comparison functionality on or off.
  • ✅ Customisable button text – Change the “Add To Compare” button label to match your brand voice.
  • ✅ Set maximum products – Allow between 2 to 10 products for comparison.
  • ✅ Enable on shop/product pages – Choose where the compare button appears.
  • ✅ Customisable table caption – Edit the heading of your comparison table.
  • ✅ Modern UI – Clean, responsive, and mobile-friendly design.
sections.installation:
1. Upload products-comparison-for-woocommerce to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce → Comparison Settings to configure:
    • Button text
    • Maximum products
    • Enable/disable on shop & product pages
    • Table caption
sections.faq:
Does this plugin support all WooCommerce themes?

Yes, it’s built to integrate with any WooCommerce-compatible theme. For best results, use a theme that follows WooCommerce coding standards.

Can I set how many products users can compare?

Yes. You can allow between 2 and 10 products in the comparison table.

Where will the “Add To Compare” button show?

You can enable/disable it on both shop pages and individual product pages.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes, the comparison table has a responsive, modern UI that adapts perfectly to mobile devices.
